title: Claude Code CI Review Findings
description: Structured output enforced via `claude -p ... --output-format json --json-schema review-schema.json` so findings can be posted as inline PR comments.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the file the finding applies to.

line.description: 1-based line number in the file for the inline comment anchor.

issue.description: What is wrong and why it matters, in one or two sentences.

severity.description: Impact tier used to route and prioritize the finding.

suggested_fix.description: Concrete, actionable remediation the developer can apply.

detected_pattern.description: Stable machine tag for the code construct that triggered the finding, enabling dedupe and false-positive analysis.
